author: Psycold
quote: I didn't even have high expectations but this is just not even GTA. This is more regressive cultural indoctrination b.s. Going to the salon, buying flowers for your girlfriend, fixing the house, buying groceries, having to fix your relationship so you can continue with missions...this is the Sims. It's pathetic how brainwashed "gamers" are to believe this is what constitutes as fun.
